item.title: Wolverine’s season ends a week too soon
item.description: The way Weiser played this past week was inspiring. Unfortunately, the magic didn’t last quite long enough. Weiser played Bonners Ferry in Grangeville on Saturday, Feb. 28. It was a close game with each team winning two quarters. Sadly, Weiser didn’t win the fourth quarter which would have sent us to State. The loss, 73-67 ended the season for our players. item.title: Weiser destroys McCall
item.description: Weiser’s Wolverines blew out the competition in their final two District tournament games against Fruitland (60-53) and McCall (65-46) to qualify for a State tournament play-in game against Bonners Ferry in Grangeville on Saturday, Feb. 28. Pictured above, front row from left, Ryker Enders, Michael Strasser, and Wes Manser. item.title: First Lady Tea honoring Nancy Grindstaff to be held March 7
item.description: Beta Sigma Phi will honor Nancy Grindstaff at a First Lady Tea on Saturday, March 7 at the Bee Hive located at 8 E. Idaho St. at 2 p.m. Please come and congratulate her on her dedication to Weiser. Date: Saturday, March 7, 2026 - 2:00pm

item.title: Washington County Rodent Board
item.description: The Washington County Rodent Board will hold its regular bi-monthly meeting on Tuesday, March 10, at 4 p.m. at the Washington County Weed Dept., located at 1118 E. Court St., Weiser, Idaho. The public is welcome to attend. Date: Tuesday, March 10, 2026 - 4:00pm
